Q&A.question: What does your family enjoy doing together on weekends?
Q&A.answer: Spending time outdoors or watching movies.

Q&A.answer: My grandmother is the oldest family member.

Q&A.question: What is a special tradition your family has?
Q&A.answer: We celebrate birthdays with a family dinner.
